thread:
Kira (Finance): Flagging Sunburst invoice 77221 - customer paid $28,700 but expected ~24.5k after tiered usage discount. They disputed via support. Uploaded bill extracts. Can ops confirm if this is billing engine or pricing-experiment issue?

billing-bot: Auto-recon: invoice=77221 mismatch. Discount rule applied: EXP-TIER-V2 not active for acct SB-220. Usage bucket calculation shows 120k tokens billed at regular rate; expected 100k-with-tier. Root cause likely pricing-experiment rollout that updated thresholds only for new accounts.

Omar (Support): Confirmed customer enrolled in beta pricing last month per sales note, but onboarding record still shows legacy-tier flag. Customer asking for a one-off credit rather than reissue.

Theo (Pricing): We rolled out EXP-TIER-V2 with a rollout flag that erroneously excluded accounts with legacy onboarding=manual. That's a bug. Agree we should credit difference for fairness. Will push fix to rollout logic.

Jenna (Legal): For credits >$1k we need documented approval. If this is clearly our experiment bug and not customer misuse, legal ok with goodwill credit. Please include memo text: "Credit issued due to internal pricing experiment misconfiguration".

Kira (Finance): Approve manual credit of $4,200 (difference). Record as "Goodwill - pricing experiment correction - Sunburst". Pat, please process and create ledger entry.

Pat (Acct Ops): Running: `/adjust-invoice 77221 credit 4200 "Goodwill - pricing experiment correction - Sunburst"` Journal BN-2026-089 created. Invoice status updated to "adjusted". Created follow-up ticket BO-1502: ensure EXP-TIER-V2 rollout includes legacy onboarding accounts and add automated smoke test.

Omar (Support): Notified customer. They replied : "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix." Closing dispute after credit posts.

Theo (Pricing): Patch merged to rollout logic and added unit test. Will monitor cohort for 2 billing cycles.

Kira (Finance): Thanks everyone. Kira out.
